title: One story threaded through two frames
concept: NextTextFrame / PreviousTextFrame chain two frames so one story flows from the first into the second.

annotations.note: Frame A. ParentStory="ustory" makes it host the story; NextTextFrame="uframeB" sends the overflow onward.
Frame A is only 60pt tall, so the story cannot finish here — the rest continues in frame B.
Frame B. Same ParentStory; PreviousTextFrame="uframeA" points back, and NextTextFrame="n" marks the end of the chain.
